description: By default only file contents are checked. When the check-filenames option is enabled, the words that make up each file's name are also checked against the correction dictionary, and a misspelling in a file name is reported on its own line giving the file path and the suggested correction (without a line number, since the match is in the name rather than in the content). Without the option, a file whose content has no misspellings produces nothing regardless of its name; with the option enabled the misspelled name is reported and counted.
